faqItems.q1: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqItems.a1: 1 unit for retail and 24+ units for volume tier pricing.
faqItems.a2: Production starts after artwork approval and finishes within the lead time on each product page.
faqItems.q3: Can I see a digital proof before production?
faqItems.a3: Yes — every order includes a digital mockup that you can approve or revise.

detail.shippingLead: Shipping: 3–7 business days depending on destination

items.format: Accepted formats: PNG, SVG, AI, PDF (vector preferred).
items.color: CMYK or sRGB color profile, transparent background where applicable.

items.shipping: Carbon-neutral shipping with DHL, FedEx and local last-mile partners.
items.returns: Custom-printed goods are non-refundable but production defects are fully covered.
items.contact: Contact support within 14 days of delivery for any quality issues.

items.q1: Do I need to design before ordering?
items.a1: No — you can browse products first, then click Customize to open the designer.
items.q2: Can I save my design and come back later?
items.a2: Yes, signed-in customers can save designs to their account.
items.a3: Sample orders are available for verified business accounts. Submit an RFQ to get started.
